title: Smoothness at a prime detected by small local Artinian lifting tests

standard_prerequisites.name: Kahler differentials and localization, the Jacobian/split differential criterion for smoothness, Artin-Rees and split-injection descent from completion.
standard_prerequisites.use: These are the named standard inputs; the selected main construction and its local nonroutine support remain in full.

core_obligations: Turn the smallest residue-field-preserving lifting tests into compatible split injections on differentials modulo all powers.
Use Artin-Rees and completion to recover the local smoothness criterion from these infinitesimal splittings.

proof_roadmap.step: Turn the smallest residue-field-preserving lifting tests into compatible split injections on differentials modulo all powers.
Use Artin-Rees and completion to recover the local smoothness criterion from these infinitesimal splittings.

difficulty_reason:
引语约定：直角引号「」内为原文逐字照抄（其中 / 表示原文换行；笔误一律照抄并标注，不静默改正）；中文弯引号内为本文措辞。行号换算：dump 行 + 37623 = algebra.tex 源行（dump 1326↔源 38949、dump 1516↔源 39139，两端及多处抽样已核）。

(a) 实质要求。条目头 b7-dump.txt:1323「### B7-08  env=lemma  label=lemma-smooth-test-artinian」、1324「### file=algebra.tex  statement_lines=[38949, 38974]  proof_lines=[38976, 39139]  proof_bytes=6186」；题面 = 源 38949–38974 = dump 1326–1351（label lemma-smooth-test-artinian，tags/tags 第 3276 行逐字「02HT,algebra-lemma-smooth-test-artinian」；题面无 reference 块、无 \cite、无署名）。题面逐字：「Let $R \to S$ be a ring map. Let $\mathfrak q$ be a prime ideal of / $S$ lying over $\mathfrak p \subset R$. Assume $R$ is Noetherian / and $R \to S$ of finite type. / The following are equivalent:」，四条依次为（原文由 enumerate 自动编号，引文按原文的 \item 行照抄）：「\item $R \to S$ is smooth at $\mathfrak q$,」「\item for every surjection of local $R$-algebras / $(B', \mathfrak m') \to (B, \mathfrak m)$ / with $\Ker(B' \to B)$ having square zero / and every solid commutative diagram … such that $\mathfrak q = S \cap \mathfrak m$ there exists a dotted / arrow making the diagram commute,」「\item same as in (2) but with $B' \to B$ ranging over small extensions, and」「\item same as in (2) but with $B' \to B$ ranging over small extensions / such that in addition $S \to B$ induces an isomorphism / $\kappa(\mathfrak q) \cong \kappa(\mathfrak m)$」。实质负担全在 (4)$\Rightarrow$(1)：条件 (4) 是极弱的提升条件——只对 small extension（definition-small-extension，源 38936–38942，逐字「We say $\varphi$ is a {\it small extension} if / $B'$ and $B$ are local Artinian rings, $\varphi$ is surjective / and $I = \Ker(\varphi)$ has length $1$ as a $B'$-module.」）且附加 $\kappa(\mathfrak q) \cong \kappa(\mathfrak m)$——要从它反推 $\mathfrak q$ 处的光滑性。这是“$R$ Noetherian + 有限型下用 Artinian 商逼近”的技术；所需材料（naive cotangent complex、small extension、局部 Artinian 环的滤链、Artin-Rees、$\Ext^1$ 与幂零交的极限论证）远超通常数学博士资格考试大纲。

(b) 允许引用的输入（本 proof 块内明写的被引件，逐条点名，括号内为同一快照 algebra.tex 源行）：definition-smooth-at-prime（37510–37517，逐字「We say $R \to S$ is {\it smooth at $\mathfrak q$} if there / exists a $g \in S$, $g \not \in \mathfrak q$ such / that $R \to S_g$ is smooth.」）；definition-formally-smooth（37804–37817：形式光滑 = 对任意平方零理想 $I \subset A$ 的 $A \to A/I$ 存在虚线箭头的提升性质）；Proposition \ref{proposition-smooth-formally-smooth}（38168–38184，smooth $\Leftrightarrow$ 有限展示 + 形式光滑；其证明只有「Follows from / Proposition \ref{proposition-characterize-formally-smooth} / and Definition \ref{definition-smooth}. / (Note that $\Omega_{S/R}$ is a finitely presented $S$-module if $R \to S$ is / of finite presentation, see / Lemma \ref{lemma-differentials-finitely-presented}.)」）；Lemma \ref{lemma-Noetherian-finite-type-is-finite-presentation}（6088 处，提供有限展示）；Lemma \ref{lemma-smooth-at-point}（37522–37569，smooth at $\mathfrak q$ $\Leftrightarrow$ $H_1(L_{S/R})_\mathfrak q = 0$ 且 $\Omega_{S/R, \mathfrak q}$ 有限自由/投射/平坦；自带 33 行证明）；Section \ref{section-netherlander}（35117 起，NL 复形记账）；Lemma \ref{lemma-differentials-localize}（34078）；Lemma \ref{lemma-differential-mod-power-ideal}（34193–34209，本条引两次）；Lemma \ref{lemma-differential-seq}（34102–34119，余法序列）与 Lemma \ref{lemma-differential-seq-split}（34157–34191，逐字「Moreover, assume that there exists / an $R$-algebra map $S' \to S$ which is a right inverse to / $S \to S'$. Then the exact sequence of $S'$-modules / of Lemma \ref{lemma-differential-seq} turns into a short exact sequence」…「which is even a split short exact sequence.」，其自身证明含两处「(omitted)」）；Lemma \ref{lemma-Artin-Rees}（12187 处）；收尾一步 Lemma \ref{lemma-split-injection-after-completion}（18141–18149 陈述、18151–18203 证明，53 行：$R$ Noetherian、$I \subset R$ 含于 Jacobson radical、$N \to M$ 有限模，若「$N/I^nN \to M/I^nM$ is a split injection」对任意大 $n$ 成立则 $N \to M$ 分裂单射；其证明用 Lemma \ref{lemma-intersection-powers-ideal-module}（Krull 交）与 $\Ext^1_R(Q, N)$ 障碍）。

(c) 必须由本证明完成的部分（逐条对应原文，源行 / dump 行）：(i) 把目标改成 NL 复形并归约到 (\ref{equation-target-map})（39007–39037 / 1384–1414）：自取展示、令 $S' = R[x_1, \ldots, x_n]/I^2$、把「Thus the map / $$ / \text{d} : / I/I^2 / \longrightarrow / S \otimes_{S'} \Omega_{S'/R} / $$」认成 NL 里的那个映射，并断言「In particular / the truth of the assertion we are trying to prove / depends only on the three rings $R \to S' \to S$.」（39021–39023 / 1398–1400）；(ii) 本条唯一真正使用条件 (4) 的一步，也是最见设计的一步（39040–39078 / 1417–1455）：对每个 $N$ 自造 Artinian 局部环 $B'_N = S'_{\mathfrak q'} / (\mathfrak q')^N S'_{\mathfrak q'}$ 与其商 $B_N = B'_N/IB'_N \cong S_{\mathfrak q}/\mathfrak q^NS_{\mathfrak q}$，把核 $I_N$ 滤成「0 \subset J_{N, 1} \subset J_{N, 2} \subset \ldots \subset J_{N, n(N)} = I_N」使每个 successive quotient 长度为 1（理由逐字「(As $B'_N$ is Artinian such a filtration exists.)」，39056 / 1433），由此「This gives a sequence of small extensions」（39057 / 1434），再「Applying condition (4) successively to these small extensions / starting with the map $S \to B_N$ we see there / exists a commutative diagram」（39063–39065 / 1440–1442），并自证 $S \to B'_N$ 自动穿过 $S_{\mathfrak q}$、又因「the maximal ideal of $B'_N$ to the $N$th power is zero」进一步穿过 $B_N$，从而「we have shown that for all $N \in \mathbf{N}$ the surjection of / $R$-algebras $B'_N \to B_N$ has a splitting.」（39077–39078 / 1454–1455）；(iii) 把“分裂”翻译成“张量后分裂单射”并按 Artin-Rees 记账（39081–39136 / 1458–1513）：用被引的余法序列与分裂判据得每 $N$ 的 $I_N \to B_N \otimes_{B'_N} \Omega_{B'_N/R}$ 是分裂单射（39086–39093 / 1463–1470），再用 Artin-Rees 找 $c \geq 0$ 使「S_{\mathfrak q}/\mathfrak q^{N - c}S_{\mathfrak q} / \otimes_{S_{\mathfrak q}} I_N = / S_{\mathfrak q}/\mathfrak q^{N - c}S_{\mathfrak q} / \otimes_{S_{\mathfrak q}} / I_{\mathfrak q'}/I_{\mathfrak q'}^2」（39102–39107 / 1479–1484）、用 Lemma \ref{lemma-differential-mod-power-ideal} 把 $\Omega_{B'_N/R}$ 换成 $\Omega_{S'_{\mathfrak q'}/R}$（39111–39124 / 1488–1501），最后「Since a split injection remains a split injection after tensoring / with anything we see that」…「is a split injection for all $N \geq c$.」（39126–39136 / 1503–1513）。

须如实标注的原文笔误（照抄，不静默改正）：源 39012（= dump 1389）在等式链末写作「\bigoplus\nolimits_{j = 1}^m S\text{d}x_j」，而同一复形在源 39002（= dump 1379）写作「\bigoplus\nolimits_{j = 1}^n S\text{d}x_j」；因 $S = R[x_1, \ldots, x_n]/(f_1, \ldots, f_m)$（源 38993、39007），微分模的秩下标应为 $n$，源 39012 的上限 $m$ 系上游笔误，按原文照抄并标注。另照抄不改的原文小疵：源 39109「(these tensor product are just a fancy way of dividing by」（product 为单数）、源 39048–39049「$B'_N$ is an Artinian local ring since it is the / quotient of a local Noetherian ring by a power of its maximal ideal.」。
